overview_description.description:
MineralSoft was founded by mineral rights owners just like you. They wanted a secure, convenient way to keep track of mineral rights and royalties. When they didn't find the solution they were looking for, they built one -- and MineralSoft was born.

Their goal is to make your life easier while maximizing the value of your minerals.
